board.name: BECom
board.notes: Two MCP2518FD CAN FD channels sharing one SPI bus, plus native CAN and RS485.

ports.name: CAN FD Battery 2
ports.notes: Shares the SPI bus with CAN FD Battery 1, so it declares only its own chip select and interrupt.

ports.name: Primary battery contactors
ports.notes: Precharge sits on GPIO45, a strapping pin that selects the VDD_SPI voltage at reset. Safe on modules with the VDD_SPI eFuse burned, which is why the board works, but the validator will warn.

ports.name: HIA4V1 precharge control
ports.notes: Reuses the primary contactor pins, so it replaces contactor_control rather than running alongside it.

ports.name: BMS power
ports.notes: Inverted in hardware: driving GPIO1 high removes power from the battery.

ports.name: Equipment stop
ports.notes: Tied low internally on hardware v1. GPIO46 is a boot-mode strapping pin, but reading it is harmless.

ports.name: SMA inverter contactor enable
ports.notes: Input from the inverter on GPIO3, the JTAG source select strapping pin. Harmless unless EFUSE_STRAP_JTAG_SEL has been burned.
